positive_label: issue_present: one or more human-confirmed customer issues

baseline.method: TF-IDF (word unigrams and bigrams) + class-balanced Logistic Regression

llm.method: Saved Gemini extraction; positive when customer_issues is non-empty

limitations: The reference set contains only 20 reviews, so results are exploratory and have high uncertainty.
The baseline is comparable only for binary customer-issue detection, not the full structured extraction task.
The LLM outputs are pre-existing predictions on the same reviewed inputs; they are not trained on these labels.
